name: canvas-study-agent
description: Lite POC: a clean, futuristic AI study-agent that launches as an LTI 1.3 tool inside a Canvas course and builds time-boxed study plans from the course's Modules.

scripts.check: for f in api/launch.js api/plan.js lib/lti.js lib/oauth1.js lib/canvas.js lib/store.js lib/r2.js lib/myprogress.js lib/connectors/index.js lib/connectors/myprogress.js lib/connectors/memory.js lib/connectors/engagement.js lib/connectors/advising.js lib/connectors/canvasprogress.js lib/connectors/livesessions.js public/app.js; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done
